'''Wind Surge''' is an [[Wind spells|air]]-based [[Surge spells|surge spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 81 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest wind spell in the game, as well as the most cost-effective surge spell to cast.

==Damage==
Wind Surge has a base maximum hit of 21 which increases as the player unlocks additional surge spells, up to 24 at level 95 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Wind Surge's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an air-based spell, Wind Surge's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to air]].
